runtime_status_repair.old_problem: Browser fetch failures, official-source outages and missing verified snapshot data were displayed together as generic failures; feature rows were hard-coded green even when their data was unavailable; maintenance UI read a non-existent GitHub source field and displayed 未記錄.
changes: Top badge now reports live official availability, browser-direct restrictions and verified snapshot fallback separately.
TWSE/TPEx/TAIFEX source cards no longer claim the official source itself failed solely because browser fetch failed.
Feature status is derived from current runtime/snapshot availability instead of hard-coded ok values.
GitHub canonical source is read from deployment.github_pages_canonical_source or project_identity.canonical_repo_path.
GitHub source update, GitHub Pages live deployment verification, CI success evidence and Cloudflare synchronization are displayed as separate states.
The source center now exposes snapshot-catalog.json and official-snapshot-latest.json coverage directly.

display_semantics.yellow: implemented but data is on-demand, browser-direct restricted, awaiting verified snapshot, or external login/runtime verification is still required
display_semantics.red: reserved for a proven blocking failure rather than ordinary browser/API reachability limits

raw_facts: The canonical official update registry contains 44 datasets.
Only twse_indices currently contains verified snapshot rows.
TWSE BWIBBU_ALL is independently readable with 2026-08-07 valuation rows, but a complete repository snapshot was not materialized in this run.
The previous UI's 2 normal / 7 failed count mixed browser fetch reachability with actual data/source state and therefore overstated source failure.
lumen_calculation: Runtime status now classifies live API success, verified snapshot fallback and browser-direct restriction separately.
Feature readiness is calculated from current STATE data and verified snapshot coverage rather than static labels.
rule_interpretation: A failed browser fetch is not sufficient evidence that TWSE, TPEx or TAIFEX is down.
Catalog registration means a dataset is in the recurring verification queue; it does not mean verified rows are already online.
Implemented code is not shown as data-available unless the corresponding runtime or verified snapshot evidence exists.
risk_limitations: Most catalog datasets still do not have complete verified snapshot rows, so several data-heavy functions can remain unavailable when direct browser access is restricted.
TWSE T86 remains registered but frontend fallback is deliberately disabled until reliable trading-date binding is implemented.
The public GitHub Pages URL could not be independently fetched by the available web layer in this run, so live propagation is not claimed.
GitHub combined status and commit workflow-run queries returned no success records for the latest status-workflow commit, so CI success is not claimed.
Cloudflare lumen-script.pages.dev writable project remains unverified/not synchronized.
